```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 1 — INSTALL AND LOAD REQUIRED PACKAGES
# =========================================================

options(
  repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"),
  timeout = 600
)

packages <- c(
  "terra",
  "flextable",
  "sf",
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "geodata",
  "lwgeom",
  "tidyr",
  "readxl",
  "stringr",
  "fixest",
  "here",
  "geosphere",
  "modelsummary",
  "ggrepel",
  "tinytable",
  "knitr"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Install packages that are not available
# ---------------------------------------------------------

missing_packages <- packages[
  !vapply(
    packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {

  message(
    "Installing missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )

  install.packages(
    missing_packages,
    dependencies = TRUE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Check that installation was successful
# ---------------------------------------------------------

still_missing <- packages[
  !vapply(
    packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(still_missing) > 0) {

  stop(
    "The following packages could not be installed: ",
    paste(still_missing, collapse = ", "),
    "\nPlease install them manually before continuing."
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Load all packages
# ---------------------------------------------------------

invisible(
  lapply(
    packages,
    library,
    character.only = TRUE
  )
)

message("All required packages are installed and loaded successfully.")

```



```{r}

# =========================================================
# CHUNK 2 — LOAD NIGHTTIME LIGHT FILES (VIIRS)
# =========================================================

# Years available in the VIIRS robustness sample
years <- 2013:2020

# File paths
ntl_files <- file.path(
  "Data/VIIRS DATA MASKED/",
  paste0("VIIRS_Azerbaijan_", years, ".tif")
)

# Check whether all files exist
if (!all(file.exists(ntl_files))) {
  stop("Some NTL files are not found!")
}

# Load annual VIIRS rasters
ntl_stack <- rast(ntl_files)

# Keep the same naming structure as before
names(ntl_stack) <- paste0("ntl_", years)


# Check files
print(ntl_files)
print(ntl_stack)
```










```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 3 — CLEAN NIGHTTIME LIGHT DATA
# =========================================================
# Negative values are invalid
ntl_stack[ntl_stack < 0] <- NA

# Maximum light across all years
ntl_max <- max(ntl_stack, na.rm = TRUE)

# Log-transform for better visualization
ntl_max_log <- log1p(ntl_max)




```






```{r}

# =========================================================
# CHUNK 4 — LOAD AZERBAIJAN DISTRICT BOUNDARIES
# =========================================================
aze <- st_read(
  here("Data", "azrbaycan_rayonlar.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Convert to sf and repair geometries
aze_sf <- st_as_sf(aze)
aze_sf <- st_make_valid(aze_sf)

# Make sure geographic CRS is WGS84
aze_sf <- st_transform(aze_sf, 4326)

# -----------------------------------------
# Transform to metric CRS
# UTM Zone 39N — suitable for Azerbaijan
# -----------------------------------------

aze_plot <- st_transform(
  aze_sf,
  32639
)

# -----------------------------------------
# Inspect available variables
# -----------------------------------------

names(aze_sf)

# Check number of administrative units
nrow(aze_sf)

# Check attribute table
st_drop_geometry(aze_sf)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
```
```{r}
# CHUNK 16 — DEFINE EVER-LIT PIXELS, BUT CLEANER VERSION
# =========================================================


# Convert NA to 0
ntl_stack_zero <- subst(ntl_stack, NA, 0)

# Count how many years each pixel has positive NTL
lit_count <- app(
  ntl_stack_zero > 0,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Keep pixels that have been illuminated in at least 3 years
ever_lit_panel <- lit_count >= 3

plot(ever_lit_panel)

cat(
  "Kept stable-lit pixels:",
  global(ever_lit_panel, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1],
  "\n"
)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 17 — CREATE PIXEL GRID ONLY FOR EVER-LIT PIXELS
# =========================================================

template <- ntl_stack_zero[[1]]

# All cell IDs
all_cells <- 1:ncell(template)

# Extract ever-lit value for all cells
ever_lit_values <- values(ever_lit_panel)

# Keep only cells where ever_lit_panel == TRUE
keep_cells <- all_cells[ever_lit_values == 1]

cat("Total raster pixels:", length(all_cells), "\n")
cat("Ever-lit pixels kept:", length(keep_cells), "\n")

# Coordinates of kept pixels
xy <- xyFromCell(template, keep_cells)

pixels_df <- data.frame(
  pixel_id = keep_cells,
  x = xy[, 1],
  y = xy[, 2]
)

head(pixels_df)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 18 — CONVERT PIXELS TO SF POINTS
# =========================================================

pixels_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pixels_df,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = crs(template),
  remove = FALSE
)

head(pixels_sf)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 19 — ASSIGN ADMINISTRATIVE DISTRICT TO EACH PIXEL
# =========================================================

# Transform current Azerbaijan administrative boundaries
# to the same CRS as the pixel dataset
aze_for_join <- st_transform(
  aze_sf,
  st_crs(pixels_sf)
)

# Assign district name to each pixel
pixels_sf <- st_join(
  pixels_sf,
  aze_for_join %>%
    select(Name_AZ) %>%
    rename(NAME_2 = Name_AZ),
  left = FALSE
)

# Check result
cat(
  "Ever-lit pixels inside Azerbaijan districts:",
  nrow(pixels_sf),
  "\n"
)

# Number of districts represented
cat(
  "Number of districts:",
  length(unique(pixels_sf$NAME_2)),
  "\n"
)

# Preview
head(pixels_sf)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 20 — EXTRACT NTL VALUES FOR EACH PIXEL AND YEAR
# =========================================================

# Extract NTL values from the ORIGINAL VIIRS stack.
# Do not use ntl_stack_zero here, because NA and 0
# should remain distinguishable.

ntl_values <- terra::extract(
  ntl_stack,
  vect(pixels_sf)
)

# Remove terra-generated ID column
ntl_values <- ntl_values %>%
  select(-ID)

# Check first rows
head(ntl_values)

# Check missing values for each year
colSums(
  is.na(ntl_values)
)

# Check that the number of extracted rows
# matches the number of pixel points
cat(
  "Pixels in pixels_sf:",
  nrow(pixels_sf),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Rows in ntl_values:",
  nrow(ntl_values),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(pixels_sf) == nrow(ntl_values)
)
```
```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 21 — INSPECT NTL DISTRIBUTION FOR SELECTED PIXELS
# =========================================================

# ntl_values was extracted from the ORIGINAL ntl_stack
# for the selected pixels in pixels_sf.

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check dimensions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "Selected pixels:",
  nrow(pixels_sf),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Rows in extracted NTL data:",
  nrow(ntl_values),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(pixels_sf) == nrow(ntl_values)
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Basic statistics for 2020
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_2020_selected <- ntl_values[["ntl_2020"]]

quantile(
  ntl_2020_selected,
  probs = c(
    0,
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.75,
    0.90,
    0.95,
    0.99,
    1
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Mean NTL by year for selected pixels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

year_means_selected <- data.frame(
  year = 2013:2020,
  mean_ntl = sapply(
    ntl_values,
    mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

print(year_means_selected)


# =========================================================
# 4. PIXEL DISTRIBUTION BY YEAR — SELECTED PIXELS ONLY
# =========================================================

years <- 2013:2020

pixel_distribution <- lapply(
  seq_along(years),
  function(i) {

    x <- ntl_values[[i]]

    data.frame(

      year = years[i],

      # Total number of selected pixels
      total_pixels = length(x),

      # Missing NTL observations
      na_pixels = sum(
        is.na(x)
      ),

      # Valid/non-missing observations
      valid_pixels = sum(
        !is.na(x)
      ),

      # Negative radiance
      negative = sum(
        x < 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # Exactly zero
      zero = sum(
        x == 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # 0 < NTL < 1
      between_0_1 = sum(
        x > 0 &
        x < 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # 1 <= NTL < 5
      between_1_5 = sum(
        x >= 1 &
        x < 5,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # 5 <= NTL < 20
      between_5_20 = sum(
        x >= 5 &
        x < 20,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # 20 <= NTL < 100
      between_20_100 = sum(
        x >= 20 &
        x < 100,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # 100 <= NTL < 500
      between_100_500 = sum(
        x >= 100 &
        x < 500,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # NTL >= 500
      above_500 = sum(
        x >= 500,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Show counts
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print(pixel_distribution)


# =========================================================
# 6. ADD PERCENTAGES OF VALID OBSERVATIONS
# =========================================================

pixel_distribution_pct <- pixel_distribution %>%
  mutate(

    negative_pct =
      100 * negative / valid_pixels,

    zero_pct =
      100 * zero / valid_pixels,

    between_0_1_pct =
      100 * between_0_1 / valid_pixels,

    between_1_5_pct =
      100 * between_1_5 / valid_pixels,

    between_5_20_pct =
      100 * between_5_20 / valid_pixels,

    between_20_100_pct =
      100 * between_20_100 / valid_pixels,

    between_100_500_pct =
      100 * between_100_500 / valid_pixels,

    above_500_pct =
      100 * above_500 / valid_pixels
  )

print(pixel_distribution_pct)


# =========================================================
# 7. CHECK WHETHER ALL VALID PIXELS ARE CLASSIFIED
# =========================================================

pixel_distribution_check <- pixel_distribution %>%
  mutate(

    classified_pixels =
      negative +
      zero +
      between_0_1 +
      between_1_5 +
      between_5_20 +
      between_20_100 +
      between_100_500 +
      above_500,

    difference =
      valid_pixels -
      classified_pixels
  )

print(pixel_distribution_check)


# =========================================================
# 8. CHECK MISSING VALUES BY YEAR
# =========================================================

cat(
  "\nMissing values by year:\n"
)

print(
  colSums(
    is.na(ntl_values)
  )
)
```

```{r}
# CHUNK 21 — CREATE WIDE PANEL DATA
# =========================================================


panel_wide <- bind_cols(
  
  pixels_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(
      pixel_id,
      x,
      y,
      NAME_2
    ),
  
  ntl_values
)

# Check
head(panel_wide)

# Dimensions
dim(panel_wide)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 22 — CONVERT TO LONG PIXEL-YEAR PANEL
# =========================================================

panel_long <- panel_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ntl_"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "ntl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(
      gsub("ntl_", "", year)
    ),
    log_ntl = log1p(ntl)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    pixel_id,
    year
  )

head(panel_long)
dim(panel_long)

# Check missing NTL observations
sum(is.na(panel_long$ntl))

```


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CLEAN ADMINISTRATIVE DISTRICTS
# =========================================================
# Current administrative boundaries are used.
# Old GADM name corrections are no longer required.
#
# Nakhchivan remains in the analytical sample.
# Selected conflict-affected districts are excluded.
# =========================================================


# -----------------------------------------
# Districts to exclude
# -----------------------------------------

excluded_districts <- c(
  "Ağdam",
  "Füzuli",
  "Cəbrayıl",
  "Zəngilan",
  "Qubadlı",
  "Kəlbəcər",
  "Laçın",
  "Şuşa",
  "Xankəndi",
  "Xocalı",
  "Xocavənd",
  "Tərtər",
  "Ağdərə"
)


# -----------------------------------------
# Check district names BEFORE filtering
# -----------------------------------------

cat(
  "Number of districts before filtering:",
  length(unique(panel_long$NAME_2)),
  "\n"
)

sort(
  unique(panel_long$NAME_2)
)


# -----------------------------------------
# Check which exclusion names actually
# exist in the current administrative data
# -----------------------------------------

districts_found <- intersect(
  excluded_districts,
  unique(panel_long$NAME_2)
)

cat(
  "\nDistricts found and to be excluded:\n"
)

print(districts_found)


# -----------------------------------------
# Check if any requested names are NOT
# present in the current administrative data
# -----------------------------------------

districts_not_found <- setdiff(
  excluded_districts,
  unique(panel_long$NAME_2)
)

cat(
  "\nRequested exclusion names not found in data:\n"
)

print(districts_not_found)


# -----------------------------------------
# Remove selected districts
# Nakhchivan is NOT excluded
# -----------------------------------------

panel_long <- panel_long %>%
  filter(
    !NAME_2 %in% excluded_districts
  )


# -----------------------------------------
# Check district names AFTER filtering
# -----------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nNumber of districts after filtering:",
  length(unique(panel_long$NAME_2)),
  "\n"
)

sort(
  unique(panel_long$NAME_2)
)


# -----------------------------------------
# Final verification
# -----------------------------------------

remaining_excluded <- intersect(
  excluded_districts,
  unique(panel_long$NAME_2)
)

cat(
  "\nExcluded districts still present in panel_long:\n"
)

print(remaining_excluded)


# -----------------------------------------
# Check Nakhchivan-related units
# -----------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nNakhchivan-related administrative units remaining:\n"
)

print(
  sort(
    unique(
      panel_long$NAME_2[
        grepl(
          "Nax|Şərur|Şahbuz|Culfa|Ordubad|Babək|Kəngərli|Sədərək",
          panel_long$NAME_2,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ]
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 23B — ADD ALTERNATIVE LOG VARIABLES
# =========================================================

panel_long <- panel_long %>%
  mutate(
    # Main specification
    log_ntl = log1p(ntl),
    
    # Robustness: small constant as in zero-light literature
    ntl_eps = ifelse(ntl == 0, 0.01, ntl),
    log_ntl_eps = log(ntl_eps)
  )

summary(panel_long$log_ntl)
summary(panel_long$log_ntl_eps)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 3A — MAP OF ADMINISTRATIVE SETTLEMENTS
# =========================================================


# -----------------------------------------
# Prepare settlement data
# -----------------------------------------

settlements_map <- aze_new %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    settlement_type = case_when(
      TYPE_AZ == "şəhər"   ~ "City",
      TYPE_AZ == "qəsəbə"  ~ "Town",
      TYPE_AZ == "kənd"    ~ "Village",
      TRUE                 ~ "Other"
    ),
    settlement_type = factor(
      settlement_type,
      levels = c(
        "Village",
        "Town",
        "City"
      )
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------
# Prepare administrative boundaries
# -----------------------------------------

aze_map <- aze_sf %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(4326)


# -----------------------------------------
# Excluded conflict-affected districts
# -----------------------------------------

excluded_area_map <- aze_map %>%
  filter(
    Name_AZ %in% excluded_districts
  )


# -----------------------------------------
# National outline
# -----------------------------------------

aze_outline <- aze_map %>%
  summarise()


# -----------------------------------------
# Create figure
# -----------------------------------------

settlement_figure <- ggplot() +

  # District polygons
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_map,
    fill = "grey97",
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +

  # Excluded districts
  geom_sf(
    data = excluded_area_map,
    aes(fill = "Excluded conflict-affected districts"),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  # Settlement points
  geom_sf(
    data = settlements_map,
    aes(
      color = settlement_type,
      size = settlement_type
    ),
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # National border
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_outline,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Colours by settlement type
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Village"    = "#2CA25F",
      "Town" = "#3182BD",
      "City"       = "#DE2D26"
    ),
    name = "Settlement type"
  ) +

  # Different point sizes
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c(
      "Village"    = 0.35,
      "Town" = 0.75,
      "City"       = 1.25
    ),
    name = "Settlement type"
  ) +

  # Excluded area legend
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Excluded conflict-affected districts" = "grey10"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        size = c(2, 2.5, 3),
        alpha = 1
      )
    ),
    size = "none",
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Administrative Settlements in Azerbaijan",
    subtitle = "Cities, Towns, and villages included in the spatial analysis"
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    datum = NA
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      10, 10, 10, 10
    )
  )


# -----------------------------------------
# Display figure
# -----------------------------------------

settlement_figure
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK — DISTANCE TO NEAREST SETTLEMENT
# AND MERGE WITH panel_long
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create unique pixel locations
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Each pixel appears several times in panel_long
# because of the yearly observations.
# Distance only needs to be calculated once per pixel.

pixel_locations <- panel_long %>%
  distinct(
    pixel_id,
    x,
    y
  )


cat(
  "Unique pixels:",
  nrow(pixel_locations),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert pixel coordinates to sf POINTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pixel_locations_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pixel_locations,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Make sure settlement data uses WGS84
# ---------------------------------------------------------

aze_new <- st_transform(
  aze_new,
  4326
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Transform both datasets to UTM Zone 39N
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EPSG:32639 gives distances in metres.

pixel_locations_utm <- st_transform(
  pixel_locations_sf,
  32639
)

aze_new_utm <- st_transform(
  aze_new,
  32639
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Find nearest settlement for each pixel
# ---------------------------------------------------------

nearest_settlement_id <- st_nearest_feature(
  pixel_locations_utm,
  aze_new_utm
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Add information about nearest settlement
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pixel_locations_utm$settlement_name <-
  aze_new_utm$NAME_AZ[
    nearest_settlement_id
  ]

pixel_locations_utm$settlement_type <-
  aze_new_utm$TYPE_AZ[
    nearest_settlement_id
  ]

pixel_locations_utm$settlement_district <-
  aze_new_utm$STATE_AZ[
    nearest_settlement_id
  ]


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Calculate distance to nearest settlement
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Distance is calculated in metres because both
# spatial datasets are in EPSG:32639.

pixel_locations_utm$dist_settlement_m <- as.numeric(
  st_distance(
    pixel_locations_utm,
    aze_new_utm[
      nearest_settlement_id,
    ],
    by_element = TRUE
  )
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Convert metres to kilometres
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pixel_locations_utm$dist_settlement_km <-
  pixel_locations_utm$dist_settlement_m / 1000


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8.1. Log distance to nearest settlement
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# log(1 + distance) is used so that pixels with
# zero distance remain defined.

pixel_locations_utm$log_dist_settlement_km <-
  log(
    1 + pixel_locations_utm$dist_settlement_km
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Create non-spatial settlement information table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

settlement_info <- pixel_locations_utm %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    pixel_id,
    settlement_name,
    settlement_type,
    settlement_district,
    dist_settlement_m,
    dist_settlement_km,
    log_dist_settlement_km
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Check settlement information
# ---------------------------------------------------------

head(settlement_info)

summary(
  settlement_info$dist_settlement_km
)

summary(
  settlement_info$log_dist_settlement_km
)

table(
  settlement_info$settlement_type,
  useNA = "ifany"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Merge nearest-settlement information
#     into panel_long
# ---------------------------------------------------------

panel_long <- panel_long %>%
  left_join(
    settlement_info,
    by = "pixel_id"
  )


# =========================================================
# FINAL CHECKS
# =========================================================

head(panel_long)

dim(panel_long)


# Missing nearest settlements
cat(
  "Missing settlement assignments:",
  sum(is.na(panel_long$settlement_name)),
  "\n"
)


# Distance summary in kilometres
summary(
  panel_long$dist_settlement_km
)


# Log distance summary
summary(
  panel_long$log_dist_settlement_km
)


# Settlement type distribution
table(
  panel_long$settlement_type,
  useNA = "ifany"
)


# =========================================================
# CHECK ONE EXAMPLE PIXEL
# =========================================================

panel_long %>%
  select(
    pixel_id,
    NAME_2,
    year,
    ntl,
    settlement_name,
    settlement_type,
    settlement_district,
    dist_settlement_km,
    log_dist_settlement_km
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    pixel_id,
    year
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1. LOAD ROAD DATA
# =========================================================

roads <- st_read(
  here::here(
    "Data",
    "Road Data",
    "hotosm_aze_roads_lines_shp.shp"
  )
)

roads <- st_make_valid(roads)

names(roads)
head(roads)


# =========================================================
# 2. DEFINE EXCLUDED DISTRICTS
# =========================================================

excluded_districts <- c(
  "Ağdam",
  "Ağdərə",
  "Füzuli",
  "Cəbrayıl",
  "Zəngilan",
  "Qubadlı",
  "Kəlbəcər",
  "Laçın",
  "Şuşa",
  "Xankəndi",
  "Xocalı",
  "Xocavənd",
  "Tərtər"
)


# =========================================================
# 3. REMOVE ROADS IN EXCLUDED DISTRICTS
# =========================================================

# Select excluded district polygons
excluded_area <- aze_sf %>%
  filter(
    Name_AZ %in% excluded_districts
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()


# Transform district polygons to road CRS
excluded_area <- st_transform(
  excluded_area,
  st_crs(roads)
)


# Combine excluded districts into one geometry
excluded_area <- st_union(
  excluded_area
)


# Remove road portions located inside excluded districts
roads <- st_difference(
  roads,
  excluded_area
)


# Remove empty geometries
roads <- roads[
  !st_is_empty(roads),
]


cat(
  "Road features after exclusion:",
  nrow(roads),
  "\n"
)


# =========================================================
# 4. CLASSIFY ROAD TYPES
# =========================================================

roads <- roads %>%
  mutate(
    road_group = case_when(

      # Major roads
      highway %in% c(
        "motorway",
        "trunk",
        "primary"
      ) ~ "major",

      # Secondary roads
      highway %in% c(
        "secondary",
        "tertiary"
      ) ~ "secondary",

      # Local roads
      highway %in% c(
        "residential",
        "living_street",
        "service",
        "unclassified"
      ) ~ "local",

      # Minor / non-road routes
      highway %in% c(
        "track",
        "path",
        "footway"
      ) ~ "minor_nonroad",

      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )


# Check road classification
roads %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(
    road_group,
    sort = TRUE
  )


# =========================================================
# 5. PREPARE ROAD NETWORK FIGURE
# =========================================================

# Keep only road categories used in the analysis
roads_map <- roads %>%
  filter(
    road_group %in% c(
      "major",
      "secondary"
    )
  )


# Excluded districts for visualization
excluded_area_map <- aze_sf %>%
  filter(
    Name_AZ %in% excluded_districts
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()


# Match CRS
roads_map <- st_transform(
  roads_map,
  st_crs(aze_sf)
)


# Azerbaijan outline
aze_outline <- aze_sf %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  summarise()


# =========================================================
# 6. PLOT ROAD NETWORK
# =========================================================

road_figure <- ggplot() +

  # District boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_sf,
    fill = "grey97",
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +

  # Major roads
  geom_sf(
    data = roads_map %>%
      filter(
        road_group == "major"
      ),
    aes(
      color = "Major roads"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +

  # Secondary roads
  geom_sf(
    data = roads_map %>%
      filter(
        road_group == "secondary"
      ),
    aes(
      color = "Secondary roads"
    ),
    linewidth = 0.30
  ) +

  # Excluded districts
  geom_sf(
    data = excluded_area_map,
    aes(
      fill = "Excluded conflict-affected districts"
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.20
  ) +

  # National border
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_outline,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.50
  ) +

  # Road colours
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Road category",
    values = c(
      "Major roads" = "#D73027",
      "Secondary roads" = "#4575B4"
    )
  ) +

  # Excluded districts
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Excluded conflict-affected districts" = "black"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Major and Secondary Road Network in Azerbaijan"
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    )
  )


# Show figure
road_figure


# =========================================================
# 7. SAVE FIGURE FOR WORD
# =========================================================

dir.create(
  here::here("Figures"),
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here(
    "Figures",
    "road_network_azerbaijan.png"
  ),
  plot = road_figure,
  width = 20,
  height = 13,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# REMOVE PIXELS LOCATED IN EXCLUDED DISTRICTS
# USING CURRENT OFFICIAL POLYGONS
# =========================================================

excluded_districts <- c(
  "Ağdam",
  "Ağdərə",
  "Füzuli",
  "Cəbrayıl",
  "Zəngilan",
  "Qubadlı",
  "Kəlbəcər",
  "Laçın",
  "Şuşa",
  "Xankəndi",
  "Xocalı",
  "Xocavənd",
  "Tərtər"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Select excluded district polygons
# ---------------------------------------------------------

excluded_area <- aze_sf %>%
  filter(
    Name_AZ %in% excluded_districts
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create unique pixel locations
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pixel_check <- panel_long %>%
  distinct(
    pixel_id,
    x,
    y
  )


pixel_check_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pixel_check,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Make CRS identical
# ---------------------------------------------------------

excluded_area <- st_transform(
  excluded_area,
  st_crs(pixel_check_sf)
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Determine which pixels fall inside excluded areas
# ---------------------------------------------------------

inside_excluded <- lengths(
  st_intersects(
    pixel_check_sf,
    excluded_area
  )
) > 0


excluded_pixel_ids <- pixel_check_sf$pixel_id[
  inside_excluded
]


cat(
  "Pixels located inside excluded districts:",
  length(excluded_pixel_ids),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Remove them from panel_long
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "Observations before:",
  nrow(panel_long),
  "\n"
)


panel_long <- panel_long %>%
  filter(
    !pixel_id %in% excluded_pixel_ids
  )


cat(
  "Observations after:",
  nrow(panel_long),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Unique pixels after:",
  n_distinct(panel_long$pixel_id),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# FINAL MAP — NIGHTTIME LIGHTS AND ROAD NETWORK
# USING FINAL CLEAN panel_long SAMPLE
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate maximum NTL for each FINAL pixel
#    over 2013–2020
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_map_data <- panel_long %>%
  group_by(
    pixel_id,
    x,
    y
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    ntl_max = max(
      ntl,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Log-transform maximum NTL
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_map_data <- ntl_map_data %>%
  mutate(
    ntl_max_log = log1p(ntl_max)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Basic checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "Pixels used in final map:",
  nrow(ntl_map_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Duplicated pixel IDs:",
  sum(duplicated(ntl_map_data$pixel_id)),
  "\n"
)

summary(
  ntl_map_data$ntl_max
)

summary(
  ntl_map_data$ntl_max_log
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert final pixel data to sf
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_map_sf <- st_as_sf(
  ntl_map_data,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Transform to UTM 39N
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_map_utm <- st_transform(
  ntl_map_sf,
  32639
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create raster template
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Use the original VIIRS raster resolution.
# First transform the original raster to UTM.

ntl_template_utm <- project(
  ntl_stack[[1]],
  "EPSG:32639"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Rasterize ONLY final panel pixels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ntl_max_log_final <- rasterize(
  vect(ntl_map_utm),
  ntl_template_utm,
  field = "ntl_max_log",
  background = NA
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Create Azerbaijan outline
# ---------------------------------------------------------

aze_outline <- aze_sf %>%
  st_transform(
    32639
  ) %>%
  summarise()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Make sure roads are in same CRS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

major_roads_map <- st_transform(
  major_roads,
  32639
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 42 — PIXEL DISTANCE TO BAKU
# PANEL_LONG — DISTANCE IN METERS
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Baku reference coordinates
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Longitude, latitude

baku <- c(
  49.8671,
  40.4093
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create UNIQUE pixel locations
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# Distance is time-invariant.
# Therefore calculate it only once for each pixel,
# not separately for every year.

pixel_baku_distance <- panel_long %>%

  distinct(
    pixel_id,
    x,
    y
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check unique pixels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "Unique pixels:",
  nrow(pixel_baku_distance),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Duplicated pixel IDs:",
  sum(duplicated(pixel_baku_distance$pixel_id)),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate distance from each pixel to Baku
#    DISTANCE IN METERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pixel_baku_distance <- pixel_baku_distance %>%

  mutate(

    dist_baku_m = geosphere::distHaversine(

      cbind(
        x,
        y
      ),

      baku
    ),

    # Log distance in meters
    log_dist_baku = log1p(
      dist_baku_m
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Check distance distribution
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nPixel distance to Baku — meters:\n"
)

summary(
  pixel_baku_distance$dist_baku_m
)


cat(
  "\nLog pixel distance to Baku:\n"
)

summary(
  pixel_baku_distance$log_dist_baku
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Add distance variables to panel_long
# ---------------------------------------------------------

panel_long <- panel_long %>%

  # Remove old versions if this chunk is rerun
  select(
    -any_of(
      c(
        "dist_baku_km",
        "dist_baku_m",
        "log_dist_baku"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  left_join(

    pixel_baku_distance %>%
      select(
        pixel_id,
        dist_baku_m,
        log_dist_baku
      ),

    by = "pixel_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. FINAL CHECKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nTotal panel observations:",
  nrow(panel_long),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique pixels:",
  n_distinct(panel_long$pixel_id),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Missing distance values:",
  sum(is.na(panel_long$dist_baku_m)),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Check first observations
# ---------------------------------------------------------

panel_long %>%

  select(
    pixel_id,
    year,
    x,
    y,
    NAME_2,
    dist_baku_m,
    log_dist_baku
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    pixel_id,
    year
  ) %>%

  head(20)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Check that distance is constant across years
#    for every pixel
# ---------------------------------------------------------

distance_check <- panel_long %>%

  group_by(
    pixel_id
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n_distances = n_distinct(
      dist_baku_m
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  filter(
    n_distances != 1
  )


cat(
  "\nPixels with inconsistent distance across years:",
  nrow(distance_check),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. SAVE UPDATED PANEL
# ---------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  panel_long,
  here(
    "Data",
    "Clean",
    "panel_long_final_2013_2020_VIIRS.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nPixel panel with distance to Baku saved successfully.\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# REGRESSION TABLE — MAIN AND ROBUSTNESS RESULTS
# =========================================================




# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------

models <- list(
  "(1) Baseline" = rf_main,
  "(2) Extended" = rf_roads_settlement_type,
  "(3) Alternative\nsettlement control" = rf_alt_settlement,
  "(4) Excluding\nBaku" = rf_no_baku
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Rename coefficients and determine their order
# ---------------------------------------------------------

coef_names <- c(
  "oil_price_brent_real:log_dist_baku" =
    "Real Brent oil price × log distance to Baku",

  "log_dist_city_m" =
    "Log distance to nearest city",

  "log_dist_major" =
    "Log distance to major road",

  "settlement_type::qəsəbə" =
    "Nearest settlement: Town",

  "settlement_type::şəhər" =
    "Nearest settlement: City"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Additional information below coefficients
# ---------------------------------------------------------

extra_rows <- data.frame(
  term = c(
    "District fixed effects",
    "Year fixed effects",
    "Spatial controls",
    "Sample"
  ),

  "(1) Baseline" = c(
    "Yes",
    "Yes",
    "No",
    "Full sample"
  ),

  "(2) Extended" = c(
    "Yes",
    "Yes",
    "City + major road",
    "Full sample"
  ),

  "(3) Alternative\nsettlement control" = c(
    "Yes",
    "Yes",
    "Settlement type",
    "Full sample"
  ),

  "(4) Excluding\nBaku" = c(
    "Yes",
    "Yes",
    "City + major road",
    "Excluding Baku"
  ),

  check.names = FALSE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create regression table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

reg_table <- modelsummary(
  models,

  coef_map = coef_names,

  statistic = "({std.error})",

  fmt = 5,

  stars = c(
    "*"   = 0.10,
    "**"  = 0.05,
    "***" = 0.01
  ),

  gof_map = c(
    "nobs",
    "r.squared",
    "adj.r.squared"
  ),

  add_rows = extra_rows,

  notes = c(
    "Clustered standard errors at the district level are reported in parentheses.",
    "* p < 0.10, ** p < 0.05, *** p < 0.01.",
    "Village is the reference category for the settlement-type specification."
  ),

  output = "flextable"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Academic formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------

reg_table <- reg_table %>%
  flextable::theme_booktabs() %>%
  flextable::autofit() %>%
  flextable::align(
    align = "center",
    part = "all"
  ) %>%
  flextable::align(
    j = 1,
    align = "left",
    part = "all"
  ) %>%
  flextable::fontsize(
    size = 9,
    part = "all"
  ) %>%
  flextable::bold(
    part = "header"
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Display table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

reg_table
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# COEFFICIENT PLOT — OIL PRICE × DISTANCE TO BAKU
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Function to extract main interaction coefficient
# ---------------------------------------------------------

extract_interaction <- function(model, model_name) {

  ct <- coeftable(model)

  estimate <- ct[
    "oil_price_brent_real:log_dist_baku",
    "Estimate"
  ]

  std_error <- ct[
    "oil_price_brent_real:log_dist_baku",
    "Std. Error"
  ]

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Estimate = estimate,
    SE = std_error,
    CI_low = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
    CI_high = estimate + 1.96 * std_error
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Combine results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

coef_plot_data <- bind_rows(

  extract_interaction(
    rf_main,
    "Baseline"
  ),

  extract_interaction(
    rf_roads_settlement_type,
    "Extended"
  ),

  extract_interaction(
    rf_alt_settlement,
    "Alternative settlement control"
  ),

  extract_interaction(
    rf_no_baku,
    "Excluding Baku"
  )
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Order specifications
# ---------------------------------------------------------

coef_plot_data$Model <- factor(
  coef_plot_data$Model,
  levels = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Extended",
    "Alternative settlement control",
    "Excluding Baku"
  )
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create coefficient plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

interaction_plot <- ggplot(
  coef_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Estimate,
    y = Model
  )
) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = CI_low,
      xmax = CI_high
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Oil Price × Distance to Baku Across Specifications",
    subtitle = "Coefficient estimates with 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Estimated interaction coefficient",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.0001
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Display
# ---------------------------------------------------------

interaction_plot


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "Figures",
    "oil_price_distance_coefficient_plot.png"
  ),
  plot = interaction_plot,
  width = 17,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
```{r}
# =========================================================
# FIGURE — FINAL ANALYSIS SAMPLE / ELIGIBLE PIXELS
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Unique pixels in final analysis sample
# ---------------------------------------------------------

eligible_pixels <- panel_long %>%
  distinct(
    pixel_id,
    x,
    y
  )

cat(
  "Eligible pixels in final sample:",
  nrow(eligible_pixels),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Administrative boundaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------

aze_sample_map <- aze_sf %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(4326)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Excluded districts
# ---------------------------------------------------------

excluded_sample_map <- aze_sample_map %>%
  filter(
    Name_AZ %in% excluded_districts
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. National outline
# ---------------------------------------------------------

aze_outline <- aze_sample_map %>%
  summarise()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------

eligible_pixels_figure <- ggplot() +

  # Administrative districts
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_sample_map,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +

  # Excluded districts
  geom_sf(
    data = excluded_sample_map,
    fill = "grey80",
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.20
  ) +

  # Eligible pixels
  geom_point(
    data = eligible_pixels,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y
    ),
    size = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +

  # National border
  geom_sf(
    data = aze_outline,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Spatial Distribution of Pixels in the Final Analysis Sample",
    subtitle = "Nighttime light pixels satisfying the sample-selection criteria, 2013–2020"
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    datum = NA
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      10, 10, 10, 10
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Display
# ---------------------------------------------------------

eligible_pixels_figure


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save for thesis
# ---------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  here("Figures"),
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "Figures",
    "final_analysis_sample_pixels.png"
  ),
  plot = eligible_pixels_figure,
  width = 20,
  height = 13,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
